item.content:encoded:
"He had caught some poor kid, who he was dragging in the air like a yo-yo! It took some time, but we finally managed to persuade him to let the kind go and to come back down."

I assume you meant "kid" instead of "kind".

Other than that minor grammatical error, this is an excellent twist on the usual events that occur in WWS Critter Profiles. Yes, some do incorporate some external GOI's such as Pot8os which included the pharmaceutical magician known as dado, and Wobbles with the selachian beating Shark Punching Center but those still maintain the wholesomeness of the animal.

Final Verdict: So without further explanation of why this is an excellent sidetracking of the usual standards of WWS without it being a total goose. I hereby give you my + 1

Oooohoohoohoo…Me likey. I find this article interesting. I mean, Wilson's Wildlife Solutions critter profiles may be one of the most "Wholesome" pages on this site. Even this looks like a normal article at first. But the twist, ooh, the sweet, sweet, twist. I mean, we never see gore or dark themes in the critter profiles.

Nice twist, Nice way to give people who prefer happy articles a shudder, +1
